_note: Toronto (TSX) listings that also trade in New York. 13F filings only cover US-listed securities, so a TSX ticker is matched to its US listing. Keys are written SYMBOL.TO (class shares with a dash: TECK-B.TO). Anything not listed here is shown as 'not covered' rather than guessed, because many TSX symbols belong to different companies in the US (T.TO is Telus, T is AT&T).
